title: Does the generator's effect-modification structure decide the method ranking?
question: When effect modification departs from the shared linear form most simulations use, does the ranking of population-adjustment methods change?
design: Anchored binary-outcome comparison with reported moments held fixed; linear, threshold, interaction and quadratic modification at three overlap levels, plus skewed covariates; unadjusted, two MAIC and two STC specifications ranked by RMSE and compared by rank correlation. 2000 replicates per cell.
